parameters.content:
# Manual replies from the dashboard
Select Header Account 2 (CRM Header Auth) on the three CRM requests, and the SAME Gmail OAuth2 account on the four Gmail requests. Run once with an empty queue to register the sending account. Then enable the schedule.

Only replies approved and explicitly confirmed in the dashboard can be claimed. Review sync must finish first. One claim per execution. NEVER retry or re-run the Gmail send node: check Gmail when delivery is uncertain. This workflow sends real email.

nodes.name: Claim approved reply
nodes.notes: Select the CustomerLead HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <private token>. No token is included in this file.

parameters.url: ={{ $('Claim approved reply').first().json.job.gmailDraftId ? 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts/' + encodeURIComponent($('Claim approved reply').first().json.job.gmailDraftId) + '?format=full' : $('Claim approved reply').first().json.job.gmailThreadId ? 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads/' + encodeURIComponent($('Claim approved reply').first().json.job.gmailThreadId) + '?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=Message-ID&metadataHeaders=References&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To' : 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/profile' }}

nodes.name: Record prepared draft
nodes.notes: Select the CustomerLead HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <private token>. No token is included in this file.

nodes.name: Send confirmed Gmail draft
nodes.notes: SENDS REAL EMAIL. Do not retry this node or restart a failed execution from it. The Gmail draft is consumed on success. Review Gmail Sent when the result is uncertain.

parameters.jsCode:
const job = $('Claim approved reply').first().json.job;
return {json:{action:'result',jobId:job.id,executionId:$execution.id,status:'Needs Review',detail:$json._mailError || 'Could not prepare the Gmail draft. No send was attempted. Check the Gmail credential and draft.'}};

nodes.name: Confirm Gmail delivery
nodes.notes: Select the CustomerLead HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <private token>. No token is included in this file.
